		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			((MMTabPageViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
			OnUOMChanged();
		}

		private void OnUOMChanged()
		{
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.SPEC_TYPE.@id", "value"));
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				ResetUOM();
				return;
			}
			string empty = string.Empty;
			string empty2 = string.Empty;
			int num = 0;
			if (text != null)
			{
				int length = text.Length;
				if (length != 4)
				{
					if (length != 9)
					{
						if (length == 11 && text == "STDVOL-FLOW")
						{
							num = 12;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						char c = text[1];
						if (c != 'A')
						{
							if (c != 'O')
							{
								if (c == 'R' && text == "PROP-DIFF")
								{
									goto IL_0125;
								}
							}
							else if (text == "MOLE-FLOW")
							{
								num = 11;
							}
						}
						else if (text == "MASS-FLOW")
						{
							num = 10;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					char c = text[0];
					if (c != 'D')
					{
						if (c != 'P')
						{
							if (c == 'T' && text == "TEMP")
							{
								num = 22;
							}
						}
						else if (text == "PROP")
						{
							goto IL_0125;
						}
					}
					else if (text == "DUTY")
					{
						num = 13;
					}
				}
			}
			if (num == 0)
			{
				ResetUOM();
				return;
			}
			num--;
			empty2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.Unit Set", "value"));
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(empty2))
			{
				empty2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("Top.appModelV8.Setup.Unit Set.Global.Input.INSET", "value"));
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(empty2))
			{
				ResetUOM();
				return;
			}
			empty = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("Top.appModelV8.Setup.Units-Sets." + empty2 + ".Unit-Types.#" + num, "value"));
			((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("UOM", (object)empty);
			_currentUOM = empty;
			return;
			IL_0125:
			string text2 = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.PROPERTY.@id", "value"));
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
			{
				string text3 = MmgExtensions.MMGGetPropSetUnit((MMViewModel)(object)this, text2);
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("UOM", (object)text3);
				_currentUOM = text3;
			}
			else
			{
				ResetUOM();
			}
		}

		private void ResetUOM()
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_currentUOM))
			{
				((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveUpdateParameter("UOM", (object)"");
				_currentUOM = "";
			}
		}

		private static double SigFigs(double value, int places)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (value == 0.0 || value == 1E+35)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			num = (int)(Math.Log(Math.Abs(value)) / Math.Log(10.0));
			return Round(value * Math.Pow(10.0, -num), -(places - 1)) * Math.Pow(10.0, num);
		}

		private static double Round(double value, int places)
		{
			return Convert.ToDouble(Convert.ToInt64(value * Math.Pow(10.0, -places))) / Math.Pow(10.0, -places);
		}

		public bool HasResults
		{
			get
			{
				if (AllSelectedRecordsCount != 1)
				{
					return false;
				}
				foreach (string selectedId in GetSelectedIds())
				{
					if (CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main." + selectedId, "type")) == "CRYSTAL")
					{
						return false;
					}
					int? num = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main." + selectedId, "status_code"));
					if (num.HasValue)
					{
						int value = num.Value;
						if ((value & 1) != 0 || (value & 4) != 0 || (value & 8) != 0 || (value & 0x10) != 0 || (value & 0x20) != 0)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public int AllSelectedRecordsCount

		private void cmdAdd_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			string text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolveParameter("main", (CxvPropertyWatch)null));
			string text2 = default(string);
			string text3 = default(string);
			bool? flag = ((MMViewModel)this).ShowAddChildDialog(text, ref text2, ref text3, false, true);
			if (flag.HasValue && flag.Value)
			{
				if (text3 == "Hierarchy")
				{
					((MMViewModel)this).EOScopeChanged("Add", "", text2);
				}
				string path = ".!" + text2;
				GoToNodeEx(path);
			}
			UpdateButtonStatus();
		}

		private void cmdEdit_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (AllSelectedRecordsCount != 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			using IEnumerator<string> enumerator = GetSelectedIds().GetEnumerator();
			if (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				string current = enumerator.Current;
				string path = ".!" + current;
				GoToNodeEx(path);
			}
		}

		private void GoToNodeEx(string path)
		{
			string text = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main");
			if (text.Contains("Blocks"))
			{
				text = text.Replace("Data.", "").Substring(text.IndexOf("Blocks"));
			}
			else
			{
				text = text.Replace("Top.appModelV8.", "");
			}
			((MMViewModel)this).GoToNode(path, (string)null, false);
		}

		private bool cmdDelete_CommandCanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			string text = parameter as string;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return false;
			}
			string text2 = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main");
			try
			{
				if (CxsConverter.ValueToActionStatusDetails(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.BatchGet(text2, "action_status", "DeleteChild")).CanInvoke)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (!(CxsConverter.ValueToBoolean(((CxvViewModel)this).ResolvedCxsProvider.BatchGet(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main." + text), "can_delete", (string)null)) ?? false))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void cmdDelete_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			string text = parameter as string;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				((MMViewModel)this).DeleteChildren("@main", (IEnumerable<string>)new Collection<string> { text }, false);
				UpdateButtonStatus();
			}
		}

		private void grid_RowDoubleClickCommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			IEnumerator<string> enumerator = GetSelectedIds().GetEnumerator();
			if (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				string path = ".!" + enumerator.Current;
				GoToNodeEx(path);
			}
		}

		private void cmdViewResults_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (AllSelectedRecordsCount != 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			using IEnumerator<string> enumerator = GetSelectedIds().GetEnumerator();
			if (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				string current = enumerator.Current;
				string text = ((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPath("@main");
				if (text.EndsWith(".Analysis"))
				{
					string text2 = ".!" + current + ".Input";
					((MMViewModel)this).GoToNode(text2, "Results", false);
				}
				else if (text.EndsWith("Pumparounds"))
				{
					string text3 = ".!" + current;
					((MMViewModel)this).GoToNode(text3, "Results", false);
				}
				else
				{
					string path = ".!" + current + ".Results";
					GoToNodeEx(path);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnAllSelectedRecordsCountChanged()
		{
			if (this.AllSelectedRecordsCountChanged != null)
			{
				this.AllSelectedRecordsCountChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
			((CxvObservableObject)this).OnPropertyChanged("AllSelectedRecordsCount");
		}

		private IEnumerable<string> GetSelectedIds()
		{
			IList gridData = grdChild_GridData as IList;
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			if (SelectedRowIndexes != null)
			{
				foreach (int selectedRowIndex in SelectedRowIndexes)
				{
					list.Add(selectedRowIndex);
				}
			}
			foreach (int item in list)
			{
				if (item >= 0 && item < gridData.Count)
				{
					grdChild_GridData_ItemTemplate grdChild_GridData_ItemTemplate = gridData[item] as grdChild_GridData_ItemTemplate;
					yield return grdChild_GridData_ItemTemplate.GetId();
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateButtonStatus()
		{
			if (((MMViewModel)this).View is MMMultifrac_Setup_ObjMan mMMultifrac_Setup_ObjMan)
			{
				mMMultifrac_Setup_ObjMan.RefreshSelection();
			}
		}
